title: codex-critic-host: take the protected baseline after the product's own registry writes, so CCH136/CCH137 pass at full check strength
goal: The cases CCH136 and CCH137 of `plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/codex-critic-host.test.mjs` pass alone (private HOME and TMPDIR), all other cases stay green (135 of 137 before), the 'repository mutation observed during normal Critic run' check keeps its FULL strength (a write by the Critic child anywhere in the candidate's git directory, including `.git/agent-pipeline/**`, is still refused), and a regression pin shows both directions. Decision by the Coordinator (PO delegated engineering decisions, 2026-10-24): Option C. The measured cause (K149 notes) is that `prepareNativeCritic` fixes the candidate fingerprint (`protectedBefore`) and the product's own launch path (`launchHeldCriticFamilyRoute` / `invokeCodexNativeCriticHost`) then reserves family-host lifetimes and members in `.git/agent-pipeline/` before the child runs, so finalize sees the product's own writes as a mutation. Fix: make the comparison baseline for the mutation check the fingerprint taken immediately before the Critic child is started (after the product's own reservations), while whatever prepare/finalize bind for other purposes (receipts, digests, the prepared-match check) stays as it is. Do NOT skip any path in `adminDirectoryInventory` (that would let the child write into the skipped subtree undetected: Options A and B of the K149 notes are rejected). If the code structure makes Option C impossible without changing a persisted receipt format, stop and report. This file is in the sha256-pinned Critic set: editing it is intended and allowed here, and the C28 re-pin is a separate later step that the Coordinator owns; do not touch `codex-isolated-critic-protected-preimage.v1.json` or any pin file. Work in your own clone `scratch/clones/k151` (`git clone --quiet . scratch/clones/k151` from the repository root). Deliver committed work in that clone plus `K151-protected.diff` / `K151-unprotected.diff` / `K151-msg-protected.txt` / `K151-msg-unprotected.txt` / `K151-notes.md` in the main checkout's `scratch/agent-out/` (message files end with the two trailer lines `AI-Assisted: true` and `Dispatch: stage-0 (elephant)` as their last paragraph; an empty diff may be omitted). The diffs must pass `git apply --check` in a second fresh clone `scratch/clones/k151-check`.
